company.name: KubeSail
company.shortDescription: Easy to use Kubernetes PaaS for individual developers and small teams!
company.description: Get a free Kubernetes Cluster, instantly! KubeSail solves an common gripe that most hackers and tinkerers have - deployment is difficult, and DevOps is harder. We make it easy to "do things right", by teaching and managing the most powerful tools! GitHub is to Git, as KubeSail is to Kubernetes!

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables individual developers and small teams to deploy and manage Kubernetes clusters easily, supporting self-hosting on various hardware including home servers and cloud.
productsAndServices.name: KubeSail Kubernetes PaaS

productsAndServices.description: A Raspberry Pi powered NAS device pre-installed with Kubernetes and KubeSail agent, designed for easy self-hosting of applications and storage at home or office.
productsAndServices.name: PiBox

productsAndServices.description: A service to create scheduled or manual encrypted backups of data within Kubernetes clusters, with cloud storage options for self-hosted applications.
productsAndServices.name: KubeSail Backups

productsAndServices.description: A service that provides automatic dynamic DNS updates and secure tunneling to expose self-hosted applications to the internet without manual router configuration.
productsAndServices.name: KubeSail Dynamic DNS and Tunneling

productsAndServices.description: A collection of Kubernetes application templates that users can deploy to their clusters, facilitating easy installation and management of common self-hosted software.
productsAndServices.name: KubeSail Templates and App Store

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,132,619 to $4,731,513, a 1.51x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 59 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
